1. Broker Contract refreshed, and the grand prize winner is changed to 'Rijo';

2. Serpents Order updated, with rewards at levels 55 and 75 changed to the "Dark Dancer" badge x15 and the "Gourmet" badge x15. and the full-level reward of the advanced secret order is changed to "Gunpowder Maniac";

notes.title: 0320版本更新前瞻
notes.content:
[New Content]
New character [Gunpowder Maniac] added, obtainable via Advanced Exchange events.
Event [Legendary Opportunity]: Active from 3/20 to 4/3. Daily first Legendary Quest will have increased drop rates for Legendary-tier items.
Event [Mountain Elixir]: Active from 4/3 to 4/17. Complete Old Man Xijin’s Bounties for rewards.
Event [Dangerous Rewards]: Active from 4/17 to 4/24. Daily first Elite Monster kill in Journey Mode will drop doubled loot.
Broker Contracts refreshed, with grand prize replaced by [Raccoon Ronin].
[Character Adjustments]

Chao’er:
Interference skill description corrected:
Original: "Adds a follow-up attack to a random ally" →
Revised: "Adds a follow-up attack to the last-row ally without one (random selection if all have it)".

Cihu:
Roaring Tiger Form (Level 6 stats) adjusted:
Original: "If this buff already exists, grants (Final Damage +10>)" →
Revised: "If this buff already exists, grants (Final Damage +50%>)".
Ambush Tiger Form description fixed:
Original: "Applies debuff (Next time displacement is caused by a skill, takes damage equal to the attack and is stunned)" →
Revised: "Applies two debuffs:
Debuff (Next displacement by a skill inflicts damage equal to the attack).
Debuff (Next displacement by a skill causes stun)."

[Bug Fixes & Optimizations]
Fixed combat reconnection errors caused by Revival mechanics.
Fixed combat freeze when Golden Poison or Mountain Elixir appeared in Retrieval battles.
Fixed combat errors when Wildland Gardener used skills on self-summoned plants.
Fixed Wildland Gardener’s skill [Spirited Plants] not affecting Stun Ferns.
Fixed Cihu’s Roaring Tiger Form Final Damage buff disappearing after one attack (now expires after one attack as intended).
Added UID display at the bottom-right during battles for easier issue reporting.
[New Character Preview: Gunpowder Maniac]

Mecha, a prodigious yet deranged craftsman from the Bian Kingdom.

He scorns traditional weapon forging, obsessing over bizarre inventions while berating peers as mediocre. His crowning achievement—revolutionizing high-efficiency gunpowder—sparked explosive mining tech and primitive firearms, earning him one of Bian’s three "Grand Craftsman" titles.

However, his manic curiosity led him to forbidden research on "Black Miasma" energy, culminating in a catastrophic accident. Stripped of his title and exiled, he now wanders as a paradox: a genius unbound by ethics, conducting perilous experiments in frenzied states—a fusion of madness and brilliance.

notes.title: 新春版本现已上线，史上最大规模更新？！
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/2f0950985987e675929587c3f8dfc09e6f086d26.jpg[/img]

最大规模更新、同时也是春节版本现已到来，新角色新活动新皮肤，感谢各位的支持！

[h1]内容新增及调整[/h1]
1.新增角色【慈虎】，可在掮客合约中可获得，为期两个月
2.新增角色【荒野花匠】，可在高级交易会中抽取
3.新增【罗盘秘境】特殊副本玩法，在困难模式的琉特城的【罗盘秘境】处进入，详见游戏公告
4.新增神之子的装扮【祥瑞玉兔】，解锁后可替换模型与技能表演；
5.新增新年七天签到，可获得【神之子】及【白光】等奖励，开放时间为1.15-2.5
6.新增巴夏精英怪【金喉密探】及对应新装备掉落，巴夏地区精英怪出现时间调整，详见游戏公告
7.新增活动【危险回报】，每日首个旅途精英怪掉落内容数量翻倍，活动日期1.15-1.30
8.新增活动【传奇机遇】，每日首个传奇任务中，传奇品质掉率提升，活动日期1.30-2.12
9.新增活动【福龟献瑞】，完成希金爷悬赏获得奖励，活动日期1.23-2.12
10.新增大量新装备，可通过罗盘秘境获得
11.新增新年特惠礼包，可在格朗特惠商城中购买
12.战斗复苏活动回归，持续至2.13
13.安尼姆大集结活动回归，持续至2.13
14.遗迹挑战的兑换商品轮换，轮换为【最初之血】，【荆棘血果】，【占卜项链】
15.朝丰铁匠处商品更换，【苦冬炉灯】更换为【光辉旅途】

[h1]角色/怪物/装备调整[/h1]
[h2]怪物：[/h2]
调整了所有海盗的属性和技能
[h2]装备：[/h2]
光辉旅途 
受到瘴气治疗+20%
调整为
受到瘴气治疗+30%
维利亚舞鞋 
速度 +4
调整为
速度 +3
北境戍寒甲 
受到滋养-50% 受到治疗-50%
调整为
受到滋养-35% 受到治疗-35%
大鹫 
最大生命值 +6 最终伤害 +5%
调整为
最大生命值 +8 最终伤害 +8%

新增词条 
息瘴 封喉 血色甲壳 凶兵 受赐 弱点洞察 此身向敌 船员入伙 剪叶生芽 棘刺 引弓 千钧 

调整词条 
控场 
新增：眩晕破抗+5%
瘴气的应许 
每20点瘴气，提升6%的瘴气易伤
调整为
每20点瘴气，提升3%的瘴气易伤
腐生（原防腐） 
新增：腐蚀伤害+10%

打磨词条扩充
火炼属性扩充
略微提升了火炼获得2条以上未燃火的概率

[h1]问题修复及优化调整[/h1]
1.修复铁王【锻灭】施加的减益效果被错误清除的问题
2.战斗中角色详情增加敌我技能的位置偏好
3.调整敌我属性的显示优先级
4.修复竞技场的排名错误显示

notes.title: 1.23 update
notes.content:
Routine maintenance is scheduled to be carried out at 15:00 on January 23 (Thursday), and the maintenance time is 1 hour. 

Repair content: 
1. Fixed the problem that when the Wild Gardener's skill [Rapid germination] summons plants, the target is wrong when adding effects to the front and back enemies. 
2. Fixed some rule errors in the Compass Secret Realm [Muddy Road]. 
3. Fixed the problem that the equipment effect [Circulation] does not take effect. 
4. Fixed the error that the number and value of the equipment effects [I am the Captain] and [Crew joining] of [Sea in a Bottle] are incorrect when adding effects. 
5. Fixed the error that the number of Buff added to the equipment effect [Facing the enemy] is incorrect. 
6. Fixed the error that the equipment effect [The Deep Sea] of [Nekark's Ring] did not randomly draw from the three effects, only stealth Stealth, and no self-damage was caused. 
7. Fixed the error that the equipment effect [Closing the throat] will take effect when the self becomes the target. 
8. Fixed the problem that there will be a freeze after using skills in some battles. 
9. Removed the option to directly abandon the elite monsters on the journey. You can continue the journey by clicking the lower right corner to temporarily skip the elite monsters.

Maintenance compensation:
 Red Crystal Pill* 200

notes.title: v1.4 update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/32881654ff74f993e09f47c4a235c8e9f78b60db.jpg[/img]

【01.15 Updates and Adjustments】
1. Added a new character [Cihu], which can be obtained in the Broker's Contract for a period of two months.
2. Added a new character [Wilderness Gardener], which can be drawn in the advanced trade fair.
3. Added the special dungeon gameplay of [Compass Secret Realm], which can be entered from the [Compass Secret Realm] in the difficult mode of Archlut City. For details, see the game announcement.
4. Added a new costume for the Blessed Prodigy[Auspicious Jade Rabbit]. After unlocking, you can replace the model and skill performance.
5. Added a new seven-day sign-in for the New Year, where you can get rewards such as [Blessed Prodigy] and [Arclight], and the opening time is 1.15-2.5
6. Added the new Ba'Xia elite monster [Goldenthroat Agent] and corresponding new equipment drops. The appearance time of elite monsters in the Ba'Xia area has been adjusted. Please see the game announcement for details.
7. New event [Dangerous Return], the amount of content dropped by the first elite monster on the journey of the day will be doubled, the event date is 1.15-1.30
8. New event [Legendary Opportunity], the first legendary mission of the day, the drop rate of legendary quality is increased, the event period is 1.30-2.12
9. New event [Lucky Turtle Offerings], complete Mr. Hilken bounty to get rewards, event date 1.23-2.12
10. Added a large number of new equipment, which can be obtained through the Compass Secret Realm.
11. Added New Year special gift packages, which can be purchased in the Grant Special Mall.
12. Battle Resurgence event returns and lasts until 2.13
13. The Anim Gathering event returns and lasts until 2.13
14. The exchange items for the Ruins Challenge are rotated, and they are [Villiya Dancing Shoes], [Arrow Feather Leather Hat], and [Divination Necklace].
15. The product at Chao Feng Smith has been replaced, [Bitter Winter Stove Lamp] has been replaced with [Glorious ].

[01.15 Character/Monster/Equipment Adjustments]
monster:
Adjusted the Attributes and skill equipment of all Pirate :
[ Glorious] "Receive +20% Miasma Mitigation" is adjusted to "Receive +30% Miasma Mitigation".
[Villiya Dancing Shoes] “SPD +4” adjusted to “SPD +3”.
[Northern Garrison Armor] "Recovery-50%, Healed -50%" adjusted to "Recovery-35%, Healed -35%".
[Great Eagle] "Max HP+ 6 Final DMG+ 5%" adjusted to "Max HP+ 8 Final DMG+ 8%".

New entries:
Restraining miasma, sealing the throat, blood-colored shell, vicious soldier, receiving a gift, insight into weaknesses, turning this body towards the enemy, crew members joining the group, cutting leaves to grow buds, thorns, drawing the bow, and a thousand pounds of force.

Adjust the entry:
[Control] Newly added: Stun Break Rate+5%
[Promise of Miasma] "Every 20 points of Miasma, increase Miasma DMG taken by 6%" is adjusted to "Every 20 points of Miasma, increase Miasma DMG taken by 3%".
[Saprophytic (formerly Anticorrosive)] New: Corrosion damage +10%

Polish the entry expansion.
Fire refining Attributes expansion.
Slightly increased the chance of obtaining 2 or more unburned fires during Fire Refining.

【01.15 Bug fixes and optimizations】
1. Fixed the issue where the Debuff effect imposed by Iron King [Forge Destruction] was mistakenly cleared;
2. The character details in battle have been updated to include the location preference of enemy and friendly skills;
3. Adjust the display priority of enemy and friendly Attributes;
4.Fixed the incorrect display of ranking in the Great blessing.

notes.title: 11.27 New version update content
notes.content:
【11.27 Update Content】
1. Addition and Adjustment of Content
1. Added the character [Fire-loving Blacksmith], and changed the theme of the advanced trade fair to [Raging Iron Forging] trade fair;
2. Added the costume of the Red Fox Prince[Moonlight White Fox], which can replace the model and skill performance after unlocking;
3. Added a limited-time event [Battle Revival], during which you can use the special function "Battle Revival" to revive the character when he dies in battle;
For detailed rules, please refer to the relevant event announcement.
4. Adjust the daily roaming map elite monsters, legendary tasks, and Broker special rewards as follows:
· Added new elite monster [Yuanmu Naughty Kids] and legendary quest [Thorns] (The Bound);
Reduce the amount of daily refresh content and increase rewards:
·· Three elite monsters will appear on the map every day, fixed rewards will be doubled, and the drop rate of epic equipment and mechanical treasure boxes will be increased;
·· Two legendary quests will appear on the daily map (one each for Ba'Xia and Fusia), the number of fixed drops in battles and fixed rewards for quests will be doubled, and the probability of other rewards appearing with probability will be doubled;
·· The Broker mission only appears in fatal mode. The rewards of the original simple mode are incorporated into the fatal mode. The rewards of the Thylacine's Treasure Map mission are doubled.
Elite monsters and legendary quests will rotate by date within a week;
5. Added the following fast travel points: Parrot Hamlet; Beaverville Bank; Nykelharp Castle; Theorb Harbor; Darkwater Fort; Calamus Village.
Deleted the fast travel point of Camellia Pass.
6. Travel effect adjustment:
If you encounter the eldest sister (green positive effect) and the third brother (Awa, random effect) among the earth mothers during your journey, you can leave directly without accepting the travel effect.
Adjustments to some travel effects:
··All members CRIT in the whole field - all members CRIT for 4 rounds
··All friendly members' DEF increased by 10%->12%
··Enemy is in a weak state--the amount of health deducted increases
·· Corrosion and Bleed Resist. of all friendly members increased by 50%->65%
7. The Broker's Contract has been updated, and the grand prize has been changed to [The Elixir] for a period of two months;
8. Added Mr. Hilken's special bounty event [Dusk Dancer ] and refreshed the corresponding redemption rewards;
9. Added adventure gift pack activity;
10. The shop items for exchanging character badges at the Broker in Gusang City are rotated: Gilded Venom, Swan Princess, One-Eyed Merc, and Renegade Badge;
11. The exchange items for the Ruins Challenge are rotated. [Villiya Dancing Shoes], [Arrow Feather Leather Hat], [Divination Necklace] are removed from the shelves, and [First Blood], [Thorn Bloodfruit], and [Ring of Promise] are put on the shelves;
12. The products at Chao Feng Smith have been replaced. [Glorious] has been removed from the shelves, and [Bitter Winter Stove Lamp] has been added.

2. Character/Monster/Equipment Adjustments
Role:
· Overall description adjustment
Skills with healing in their descriptions are now also considered healing skills. [Unique Appetite] [Sea Mist] [Arrogant Stance] [Entering Provocation]
The Elixir
[The courage to cut off the tail]
Adjustment: "When you take damage, your HP is reduced to 1, and you heal other teammates based on the reduced HP" ---> "When your HP is greater than 1, you take damage equal to 95% of your current HP, and you heal other teammates based on the reduced HP"
【Eliminary Elixir for the Timid】
New: Clear your own "Impair" status
Dusk Dancer
【Select a dance partner】
Adjustment: The duration of the Buff(guaranteed DGE) has been adjusted to last until the start of the next round.
· The Epicurean
【Unique Appetite】
Tweak: Miss/ DGE will not apply Mark
【Craftsmanship】
Tweak: Miss/ DGE will not clear the Mark
· The Renegade
【Return to Shadow】
Adjustment: The duration of Stealth is adjusted to two rounds at low levels

monster:
Secret Order Ranger (CRIT Growth Reduced)
Yellow Garb (Fists)(HP growth adjustment)
Yellow Garb Priest([Yellow Brand] damage, CRIT, attack position weakened)
Lynx Painter (Mark time increased)
Feather Dart Thrower([Shooting] CRIT Weakened)

equipment:
Entry Adjustment
[Blood throbbing]
Adjustment: Increase CRIT based on the number of characters in the enemy's Bleed state → Increase CRIT based on the number of characters in the Bleed state on both sides.
【Drinking poison】
Adjustment: Increase Final Heal → Increase Final Heal when releasing a healing skill.
[The trapped beast]
Effect adjustment (LV3): Final DMG + 25%
【Take advantage of the fire】
Effect adjustment (LV3): When the enemy's health is less than 50%, the damage is increased by 20%.
【Repel the enemy】
Tweaked: Gain additional Buff to increase DEF Penetration .
[Self-healing]
New: At LV1 and LV2, Impair will further reduce SPD .
Adjustment: HP recovery increased for LV1 and LV2.

3. Problem repair and optimization adjustments
1.Fixed the error of incorrect product name color when viewing the store;
2. Fixed the issue where the process of clearing Decadence in Calico Teahouse was stuck due to insufficient Silver Dragon;
3. Fixed the issue of incorrect character portrait when upgrading skills;
4. Fixed the issue that the main interface could not be opened after closing the interface when accepting a task during travel;
5. Optimize the interface logic of fire refining, blessing, and polishing. When entering the equipment/props selection, you can return to the previous level;
6. The acceleration function is adjusted to be enabled after completing [Ambush on All Sides];
7. Some skill description errors have been adjusted;
8. Adjusted the pop-up timing of some pop-up windows;
9. Reduce the black screen duration during breaks;
10. Added frame rate setting and vertical synchronization function (PC only);
11. Added the logic of exiting the interface with the ESC key in friend invitation, Mr. Hilken activity interface, blessing, fire refining, polishing and other interfaces (only on PC);
12. Fixed the issue where cards repeatedly moved up and down when the mouse moved to the bottom of the card during battle (PC only);
13.Optimize the operation experience of position switching (PC only).
